10 <p>.github/workflows/tag-check.yml (1433 bytes)</p><pre class="src"><a id="l1" href="#l1">1</a> name: tag-check
11 <a id="l2" href="#l2">2</a> 
12 <a id="l3" href="#l3">3</a> # F-Droid builds each new v* tag by itself. This workflow checks the tag first.
13 <a id="l4" href="#l4">4</a> on:
14 <a id="l5" href="#l5">5</a>   push:
15 <a id="l6" href="#l6">6</a>     tags: [&quot;v*&quot;]
16 <a id="l7" href="#l7">7</a> 
17 <a id="l8" href="#l8">8</a> jobs:
18 <a id="l9" href="#l9">9</a>   check:
19 <a id="l10" href="#l10">10</a>     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
20 <a id="l11" href="#l11">11</a>     steps:
21 <a id="l12" href="#l12">12</a>       - uses: actions/checkout@v4
22 <a id="l13" href="#l13">13</a> 
23 <a id="l14" href="#l14">14</a>       - name: Tag matches gradle.properties
24 <a id="l15" href="#l15">15</a>         run: |
25 <a id="l16" href="#l16">16</a>           name=$(sed -n &#x27;s/^assistkey.versionName=//p&#x27; gradle.properties)
26 <a id="l17" href="#l17">17</a>           code=$(sed -n &#x27;s/^assistkey.versionCode=//p&#x27; gradle.properties)
27 <a id="l18" href="#l18">18</a>           test &quot;v$name&quot; = &quot;$GITHUB_REF_NAME&quot; || { echo &quot;Tag $GITHUB_REF_NAME does not match versionName $name&quot;; exit 1; }
28 <a id="l19" href="#l19">19</a>           test -f &quot;fastlane/metadata/android/en-US/changelogs/$code.txt&quot; || { echo &quot;Missing changelogs/$code.txt&quot;; exit 1; }
29 <a id="l20" href="#l20">20</a>           grep -q &quot;^## $name &quot; CHANGELOG.md || { echo &quot;CHANGELOG.md has no entry for $name&quot;; exit 1; }
30 <a id="l21" href="#l21">21</a> 
31 <a id="l22" href="#l22">22</a>       - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
32 <a id="l23" href="#l23">23</a>         with:
33 <a id="l24" href="#l24">24</a>           distribution: temurin
34 <a id="l25" href="#l25">25</a>           java-version: &quot;21&quot;
35 <a id="l26" href="#l26">26</a> 
36 <a id="l27" href="#l27">27</a>       - name: Unit tests and F-Droid build
37 <a id="l28" href="#l28">28</a>         run: ./gradlew testFullDebugUnitTest assembleFdroidRelease
38 <a id="l29" href="#l29">29</a> 
39 <a id="l30" href="#l30">30</a>       - name: F-Droid build has no bundled app and no billing library
40 <a id="l31" href="#l31">31</a>         run: |
41 <a id="l32" href="#l32">32</a>           apk=$(ls app/build/outputs/apk/fdroid/release/*.apk)
42 <a id="l33" href="#l33">33</a>           if unzip -l &quot;$apk&quot; | grep -q &quot;assets/bundled&quot;; then echo &quot;Bundled app in APK&quot;; exit 1; fi
43 <a id="l34" href="#l34">34</a>           for dex in $(unzip -Z1 &quot;$apk&quot; | grep &#x27;\.dex$&#x27;); do
44 <a id="l35" href="#l35">35</a>             if unzip -p &quot;$apk&quot; &quot;$dex&quot; | grep -aq &quot;billingclient&quot;; then echo &quot;Billing library in APK&quot;; exit 1; fi
45 <a id="l36" href="#l36">36</a>           done</pre>
